titolo: Why the Deep Amazon Is Still Off Limits to Humans

scene.testo: In the Amazon, some people have never met us.
Satellites photograph every inch of this forest.
Yet on the ground, huge areas remain almost unknown.
Brazil has recorded dozens of isolated groups here.
Even approaching them is forbidden by law.
But the law is only one reason.
The canopy blocks most of the sunlight above the ground.
Under it, tangled vines swallow every trail.
Each year, rising rivers flood forest for miles.
Insects, snakes and disease wait in the undergrowth.
The Amazon River carries more water than any other river.
Its tributaries cut the forest into endless islands.
But that's not the strangest part.
Isolated people can die from a common flu.
Our germs can destroy them before we ever speak.
The Man of the Hole lived alone for decades.
He was the last survivor of his people.
So the greatest barrier is protecting them from us.
Let's go deeper into the green.
